import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fit(model, n, trials=30):
    best=None
    np.random.seed(2)
    for _ in range(trials):
        p0=np.abs(np.random.randn(n))*0.5+0.05
        r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(model(p)-sigma,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6), p0)
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    return best, np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(sigma)

 "power+lin": (lambda p: p[0]*np.abs(eps)**p[1]+p[2]*eps, 3),

}
